evidence_spans.text: Analysis of Connectivity Map data revealed further evidence that MEK inhibitors do indeed induce highly similar gene expression signatures to HSP90 perturbations
In total, we profiled ~650,000 single-cell transcriptomes across ~5000 independent samples in one experiment.
HDAC inhibition led to sequestration of acetate in the form of markedly increased acetylated lysine levels after exposure to a 10 μM dose of the HDAC inhibitors pracinostat and abexinostat

trametinib-treated A549 and K562 cells, which harbor activating KRAS and ABL mutations, respectively, were tightly clustered, consistent with a strong, specific transcriptional response to inhibition of MEK signaling by trametenib
Hash oligos facilitated the identification of the vast majority of interspecies doublets (95.5%)
these results suggest that a major feature of the response of cells to HDAC inhibitors, and possibly their associated toxicity, is the induction of an acetyl-CoA-deprived state.

This suggests that the dose of many HDAC inhibitors governs the magnitude of a cell's response rather than its rate of progression and that any observed heterogeneity cannot be attributed solely to asynchrony
after drug exposure at the highest dose, only 52 (27%) compounds caused a decrease in viability of 50% or more
After fitting a response curve to the recovered cellular counts, we inferred a 'viability score' from sci-Plex data, a metric that was concordant with 'gold standard' measurements
A total of 7561 genes were sensitive to at least one drug

We used Monocle 3 to visualize these data ... To quantify the 'population average' transcriptional response of A549 cells to each of the four drugs, we modeled each gene's expression as a function of dose through generalized linear regression. A total of 7561 genes were sensitive to at least one drug... Additionally, we evaluated whether the number of cells recovered at each concentration could be used to infer toxicity akin to traditional screens. After fitting a response curve to the recovered cellular counts, we inferred a 'viability score' from sci-Plex data, a metric that was concordant with 'gold standard' measurements
acetate, pyruvate, and citrate supplementation was capable of blocking pracinostat-treated cells from reaching the end of the HDAC inhibitor trajectory
In total, 6238 genes were differentially expressed in a dose-dependent manner in at least one cell line (FDR < 5%)
We observed 99.1% concordance between species assignments on the basis of hash oligos versus endogenous cellular transcriptomes

Of the 4308 genes that were significantly differentially expressed over this consensus trajectory, 2081 (48%) responded in a cell-type–dependent manner and 942 (22%) exhibited the same pattern in all three cell lines
we obtained transcriptomes for 649,340 single cells
The aggregate expression profiles for each cell type were highly concordant between replicate wells (Pearson correlation = 0.99)
In MCF7 cells, both ACLY and ACSS2 inhibition shitted cells farther along the HDAC inhibitor trajectory, although no such shift was observed in A549

we performed a 'barnyard' experiment. We separately seeded human (HEK293T) and mouse (NIH3T3) cells to 48 wells of a 96-well culture plate. We then performed nuclear lysis in the presence of 96 well-specific polyadenylated ssDNA oligos ('hash oligos') and fixed the resulting nuclear suspensions with paraformaldehyde. ... We observed 99.1% concordance between species assignments on the basis of hash oligos versus endogenous cellular transcriptomes. Additionally, the association of hash oligos and nuclei was stable to a freeze–thaw cycle
